descriptions.tend: Tend.am is an online marketplace for services in Armenia where clients post tenders (job requests) for free and verified professionals submit blind bids. Instead of scattered outreach on social media and unclear pricing, a client publishes one request, receives multiple offers, compares them, and picks the best provider. How it works Client — describes the job, attaches photos/documents, sets a deadline and budget. Professional — submits price, timeline, and a cover message. Until the tender closes, they cannot see competitors’ bids (blind bidding). Client — after the deadline, compares offers, awards the winner, and completes the job with a review. Key features Service categories and locations Public specialist profiles (portfolio, credentials, reviews) Email and Telegram verification Wallet (AMD) for participation fees Admin moderation, support chat, notifications
